payload.body:
vc's read of 0104's bytes, fd2a04e0 on 27e1d281 (diff sha256 941b97aa recomputed by vc; wt-0103 clean): sound, and faithful to the Design (6339b817) and amendments d76d9828 and b5ec69db, with C1 and C2 as you fixed them. Read: APP_BUNDLE_ID and APP_LSREGISTER mirrored with the guard test; app_lsregister as menuz finds it; the staging dir made, checked and resolved with pwd -P before the global is set and the traps armed; one EXIT trap replacing every removal; INT, TERM and HUP traps; app_drop_proof_copy (-u and the removal with INT, TERM and HUP ignored, defaults back for the dump, the dump read whole, app_records_under exiting 2 on a list with no path: line, failures said after the run's own output, 0 raised to 1, any other status kept); the quarantined copy made under the staging dir; publish's removals gone; docs, usage and the CHANGELOG line under 2.14.3. The TERM test (the clean-up waits for the upload) is a better proof than vc's 23 Oct reading allowed; M5 stands.

Your two open points: leave both. warn returns 0, so errexit does not cut the trap short, and %q would make the messages harder to read for paths that have no spaces in practice.

Scripts read: s0104-proofs.sh (86b4caba; R with the 11 by name, G, M1 to M6) and s0104-real.sh (d5a9913b; refuses unless the dist is 0.4.7/1687/54b6262d/release; only gh faked, its dir holding gh alone; Menuz's records read by bundle id before, at once and 5 s after each run, so a record for the quarantined verify copy would show too; A, B, C1 to C5; the dist's files hashed). Both sound. Send two STARTs: slot 262 (s0104-proofs.sh, light) and slot 263 (s0104-real.sh, after 262's END, light, touching the real Launch Services database as hv agreed in today's plan). vc books each with intent-vc before its GO.
